title: System context
description: Cropwright is a pure frontend behind its own nginx origin. One API prefix is proxied to the OpenProcessor API, which fronts OpenSearch, Triton, the VLM, the trainer/evaluator and the segmenter.
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Browser["Browser"]
  Nginx["Cropwright nginx\n(non-root, :8080)"]
  API["OpenProcessor API\n(one prefix, e.g. /curation)"]
  OS[("OpenSearch\ncrops / clusters / classes")]
  Triton["Triton\nmodel registry + inference"]
  VLM["VLM\nsuggestions + verification"]
  Trainer["Trainer / evaluator\ntraining + bake-off"]
  Seg["Segmenter\nregion candidates"]

  Browser -- "same-origin HTTPS" --> Nginx
  Nginx -- "docker network, prefix proxy" --> API
  API --> OS
  API --> Triton
  API --> VLM
  API --> Trainer
  API --> Seg

title: Labeling workflow
description: The end-to-end loop every dataset goes through, one page per step.
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Ingest["Ingest\n/ingest"] --> Detect["Region detection + VLM\n(backend, async)"]
  Detect --> Clusters["Clusters\n/clusters"]
  Clusters --> Review["Review\n/review"]
  Review --> Classes["Classes\n/classes"]
  Classes --> Export["Export + holdout\n/export"]
  Export --> Train["Train\n/train"]
  Train --> Bakeoff["Bake-off\n/bakeoff"]
  Bakeoff --> Promote["Promote\n(Triton registry)"]
  Promote --> Probe["Probe predictions\n(feeds review)"]
  Probe --> Review

title: Frontend internals
description: SvelteKit routes call api.ts, which is the only place wire shapes are known. Runes-based stores and the served region profile drive what actually renders.
mermaid:
flowchart TB
  Routes["SvelteKit routes\n/dashboard /ingest /clusters /review /classes /export /train /bakeoff /models /settings"]
  Controllers["Controllers\nreviewController, clusterController,\nslotGalleryController, ingestRunController"]
  ApiTs["src/lib/api.ts\napiFetch + wire mapping"]
  Stores["Runes stores\nclassesStore, strategiesStore, regionProfileStore"]
  Slots["Slot registry\nservedRegionSlot + tier-2 annotation-profiles.json"]
  Contract["Vendored API contract\ncontracts/openprocessor/*"]

  Routes --> Controllers --> ApiTs
  Routes --> Stores
  Stores --> ApiTs
  Routes --> Slots
  Slots --> ApiTs
  ApiTs -. checked against .-> Contract
